config.paper_source: Carlini et al. 2021 section 6.1 log-perplexity ratio

methodology.paper_attack: Reference/calibration MIA: compare target LM likelihood to a reference LM likelihood.
methodology.llm_adaptation: Positive and negative FL worlds differ by target-client membership; after Flower (flwr) FedAvg simulation, score the target record under the final FL model versus the base reference model.
methodology.deviation_from_source: The smoke run uses a deterministic toy causal scorer. Set use_hf_models=True for genuine federated fine-tuning of an open-source LLM with the Flower (flwr) FedAvg simulation.

metrics.low_fpr_note: Null denotes insufficient empirical FPR resolution; no population guarantee.

evaluation_scope: FL adaptation; not a reproduction of the source benchmark
pipeline_evaluation_scope: Study-specific FL defense/RAG adaptation; not a source benchmark reproduction

rag_validity.interpretation: Compare defense effects only against informative ordinary retrieval at useful task performance.
